verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's own SDK and CLI run models on-device. Prompts, audio and images stay on the phone and work offline without an account, and hosted execution only happens when the user explicitly opts in. Keeping data local means it never reaches the vendor, which indirectly keeps it out of any training pipeline. However, nothing in the evidence addresses training-data use itself, so this is privacy-by-locality rather than a stated no-training guarantee. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out control for Wally Cloud hosted requests, documented data-retention terms, and independent verification that no data is collected.
